meta.name: yfm
meta.description:
YAML front matter (YFM) convention for markdown articles — memory entries, design notes, blog posts, RUNBOOKs, READMEs, any prose an agent or a pipeline may scan.
Top-level fields (title, tag, link, date, author) for indexing and discovery. The `x-meta:` block is the x-cmd extension: it carries ontology fields that link the article into x-cmd's knowledge graph via `x ondb`.
Apply unless a stricter spec forbids front matter. Helpers: `x yfm` (in design).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 Markdown 文章添加标准化的 YAML 头部元数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常写 Markdown 文章并需要统一管理元数据
copy.tagline_en: Add standardized YAML front matter to Markdown articles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Markdown articles and need unified metadata management

howto.what: 当 Claude 处理 Markdown 文章时，会自动在文件开头添加 YAML 格式的元数据块（YFM），包含标题、标签等索引信息，并支持 x-meta 扩展字段用于知识图谱关联。
howto.when: 当 Claude 生成或处理任何可能被搜索索引或知识图谱扫描的 Markdown 文章时触发，除非遇到更严格的规范（如 GitHub README、Hugo/Jekyll 等已有自己的元数据格式）或 Markdown 检查工具报错。

say.text: 帮我写一篇设计笔记，加上 YFM 元数据。
给这篇博客添加 x-meta 字段，类型设为 Memory。

howto.what_en: When processing Markdown articles, Claude automatically adds a YAML front matter block at the top with fields like title and tags for indexing, and supports an x-meta extension for knowledge graph linking.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude generates or processes any Markdown article that may be scanned by search indexes or knowledge graphs, unless a stricter spec (e.g., GitHub README, Hugo/Jekyll) or lint errors forbid it.

say_en.text: Write a design note with YFM metadata.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a YAML header with title, tag, etc.

say_en.text: Add x-meta fields to this blog post, set type to Memory.
say_en.note: Claude will insert an x-meta block with type set.
